description: Ex RAF WJ875 (c/n 71371), delivered 26 February 1971, damaged 30 March 1993; earlier displayed at the Patito Sirirí barrancas, rebuilt by II Brigada and technical school students and re-erected on the roundabout at the tunnel access in 2014. Photographed April 2017 and June 2022.
aliases: Canberra T64; Canberra B62; WJ875; c/n 71371
museum_name: Canberra B-112 Túnel Subfluvial Roundabout Monument, Paraná
